# FG-REPO-0025

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 404 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_missing_spec_version_is_spec_version_not_found` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 参照している仕様のリポジトリに、指定した版（タグ）またはブランチがありません。.forge/repo.yml の version / track を確かめてください。
- en: The referenced specification repository has no such version (tag) or branch. Check version / track in .forge/repo.yml.
- id: Repositori spesifikasi yang dirujuk tidak memiliki versi (tag) atau branch tersebut. Periksa version / track di .forge/repo.yml.

## 原因 (cause)

`GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/repository/spec-refs` (M3 X1): an entry `repo: <path>` with `version: <tag>` (or `track: <branch>`) named a repository the reader may read (SpecRefRead allowed on it with the reader's own permissions), but `refs/tags/<tag>` (`refs/heads/<branch>`) does not exist there or does not name a commit. Reported per entry (`status: "version_not_found"`, `error_code`), never for a repository the reader cannot read (that is FG-REPO-0026, so the answer never tells which tags a hidden repository has). The other entries are still resolved.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event `forge.spec_refs.unresolved` (info) carries `error_code`, `request_id`, `project_id` (the referencing project), `referenced_project_id`, `line` (the entry's line in .forge/repo.yml), `pin` (version / track) and `reason` (ref_not_found, not_a_commit); never the tag name. List the referenced repository's tags: gstn browse refs --project <referenced_project_id> --type tag, or on the server git --git-dir <storage path> for-each-ref refs/tags.

## 対処 (fix)

Publish the tag in the specification repository, or correct `version:` / `track:` in .forge/repo.yml to an existing one. A tag pushed a moment ago may be missing for up to 5 s (the ref list cache).
